criteria: directory-ascent file/root discovery using parent traversal
explicit candidate probing where a function searches among possible file paths

functions.name: rg_build_command
functions.description: Builds ripgrep commands for root search or explicit candidate-file search.

functions.name: rg_search
functions.description: Primary discovery entrypoint; searches by root or by provided file list and yields match records.

functions.name: discover_uri_links
functions.description: Searches markdown files for external-link patterns and returns discovered source-link records.

notes: Current implementation still uses legacy rg_search calling style and NDJSON row parsing.

functions.name: build_slug_index
functions.description: Searches for slug-field candidates and builds a slug-to-path index used for write-back routing.

notes: Current implementation still uses legacy rg_search calling style and NDJSON row parsing.

functions.name: _discover_slug_sentinel_files
functions.description: Searches for files containing slug placeholder sentinels.

functions.name: _find_files_with_slug_value
functions.description: Searches candidate files containing slug fields before exact metadata checks.

functions.name: find_vault_root
functions.description: Searches upward through parent directories for a vault marker (.obsidian).

notes: rg_search call sites currently use legacy positional/NDJSON contract.

functions.name: _discover_files
functions.description: Recursively walks a root tree, filters ignored paths/suffixes, and collects file records for duplicate analysis.

functions.name: compile_patterns
functions.description: Searches the regex source directory for *.yaml pattern files and compiles each one.

functions.name: compile_regex_registry
functions.description: Searches the studio regex directory for *.yaml files to compile into runtime JSON registry artifacts.

functions.name: _copy_template_without_overwrite
functions.description: Recursively enumerates template files/directories and copies missing items into a target vault.

functions.name: is_vault
functions.description: Searches for known registry marker files to determine whether a path is a vault.

functions.name: _find_vault_root_for_file
functions.description: Searches upward from a file path to find a vault root with required marker directories.

functions.name: _resolve_template_path
functions.description: Searches for a template among candidate relative/absolute paths, including implicit .md fallback.

functions.name: discover_commands
functions.description: Searches the CLI package directory for command modules and registers those exposing main().

discovery_queries.import_scan: rg -n "workbench\.lib\.rg|from workbench\.lib import rg|import workbench\.lib\.rg" workbench
